title: eDNA Extraction Protocol from Water Samples Using GFF Filters and Bento Lab
author: Vid Švara

steps.title: Add Proteinase K and Mix
steps.instruction: Add 20 µL of Proteinase K to each 5 mL tube that contains the GFF filter and ATL buffer, then vortex briefly or manually shake to mix.

steps.title: Incubate Lysate at 56°C
steps.instruction: Incubate the tubes in the Bento Lab heat block at 56 °C for 1–3 hours (or overnight for better yield), making sure the filters are fully submerged.

steps.title: Transfer Lysate to New Tube
steps.instruction: After incubation, transfer 400 µL of the lysate (avoiding large filter fragments) into a new 1.5 mL tube.

steps.title: Add AL Buffer and Mix
steps.instruction: Add 400 µL of AL buffer (1:1 ratio) to the lysate and mix thoroughly.

steps.title: Add Ethanol and Mix
steps.instruction: Add 400 µL of 96–100 % ethanol and mix again by vortexing or pipetting up and down.

steps.title: Load Mixture onto Spin Column
steps.instruction: Apply 600 µL of the mixture to a Qiagen spin column in multiple aliquots; centrifuge at 6,000–8,000 rpm for 1 minute in the Bento Lab centrifuge. Discard the flow‑through each time and repeat until all lysate from the 1.5 mL tube has passed through the column.

steps.title: Wash Spin Column
steps.instruction: Perform the wash steps according to the original Qiagen protocol.

steps.title: Elute DNA
steps.instruction: Place the spin column in a new 1.5 mL Eppendorf tube, add 80 µL of Buffer AE or nuclease‑free water, incubate at room temperature for 1 minute, then centrifuge for 1 minute to elute DNA.

steps.title: Optional Inhibitor Removal or Storage
steps.instruction: An inhibitor removal step can be performed on each sample, or the samples may be stored at –20 °C until further analysis.
